sources.verification: Official OpenProblems public S3 bucket inventory. Range GET of CITE mod1 and Multiome mod2 returned HTTP206 with HDF5 signature; YAML metadata describes layers/counts and layers/normalized, obs/day and obs/donor. Counts layer retains original feature counts. Metadata shape is 119191 CITE cells, 161868 Multiome cells and four donor colors; stale BMMC/12-donor prose conflicts with organizer loader HSPC description. Verify donor13176 on acquired artifact before paper preprocessing.
sources.reproduction_note: Public April2024 organizer artifact, not authors exact five-PC whitened artifact. Use counts and recompute donor-selected five PCs with frozen preprocessing; do not use organizer X_pca automatically. log_cp10k selected as canonical downloadable artifact; other normalizations contain same count data, not distinct experimental datasets.
